justification: JTAGG JTDI launch is uncharacterized. Falling-edge receive and one-cycle control alignment are checked by mapped RTL and real-board 128-bit scan/WRITE64 regressions; this is not numerical boundary STA.
JTAGG CE1/SHIFT launch is uncharacterized. Registered falling-edge control is checked by mapped RTL and physical JTAG frame regressions; this is not numerical boundary STA.
JTAGG UPDATE launch is uncharacterized. Falling-edge sampling and one-shot update acceptance are verified by RTL and real-board regressions; UPDATE is not a fabric clock.
First stage of the JTCK-to-CPU request toggle synchronizer. The source holds the bundled mailbox, the next CPU stage consumes the synchronized toggle, and reset/relock behavior is checked separately.
